annotations.title: Put a workout on a 1:1 client's day

description: Use this when a Phorme coach has written a workout for one of their 1:1 clients and wants it on the client's plan. It writes it as a real session on that day, marked from the coach, with loads filled from the client's maxes where the coach gave none; the client can undo it in the app. replace true rewrites the workout the coach already put on that day. Send the workout exactly as the coach wrote it. Set confirmation to true only after the coach said yes to this workout for this client.

brain_id.description: The brain id of the coach's own build, for example "cameron".

client_id.description: The client_id of one of the coach's 1:1 clients, from coach_clients.

confirmation.description: True only after the coach said yes to this workout for this client.

date.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD. Today when left out.

group.description: The same label on two movements makes them a superset.

meters.description: A carry, sled or run by distance, instead of reps.

note.description: A tempo, drop set or cue, on the last set.

reps_to.description: The top of a rep range.

seconds.description: A hold or timed set, instead of reps.

replace.description: True to rewrite the workout the coach already put on that day.

title.description: A short name, for example "Lower A".

name: coach_client_workout
title: Put a workout on a 1:1 client's day
